hotels.title: Phillip Island Villa Retreat Across 65 Acres of Bushland
hotels.description: Retreat to an expanse of native gardens and bushland, as this relaxed Phillip Island retreat gives you space to switch off between wildlife encounters, beach days and island drives. Choose a self-contained studio or multi-bedroom villa with kitchen facilities, living areas and outdoor space, then make use of the resort’s pools, tennis courts, fitness centre, and walking and cycling tracks. Flametrees Restaurant serves breakfast and dinner onsite, while the Penguin Parade, Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit and Cowes are all within easy reach. With a tranquil setting and practical facilities for couples and families, it’s a comfortable base for exploring the island.
